steps.text: I will look up the order details to see its promised delivery date, fulfillment status, items, and warehouse as a starting point.
I will check inventory for SKU-404 at WH-ATL to see if a stock shortage is preventing fulfillment.
I will search other warehouses for SKU-404 that can alone cover the shortfall of 22 units, to see if a stock transfer could resolve the shortage.

arguments.summary: ORD-1002 has not been fulfilled because WH-ATL lacks sufficient stock of SKU-404 (only 8 available vs 30 ordered). No other single warehouse can cover the 22-unit shortfall for a transfer.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1002 for Bluebird Labs at WH-ATL, fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-18; ship_by_date 2026-03-16; is_past_promised_date false; is_past_ship_by_date false.
check_inventory: SKU-404 at WH-ATL on_hand 10, reserved 2, available 8 (ordered 30).
find_alternative_stock: SKU-404 shortfall 22; WH-BOS available 8 (can_cover_required_quantity false); WH-CHI available 6 (false); WH-DAL available 5 (false); warehouses_with_sufficient_stock [].
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient available stock of SKU-404 at WH-ATL (8 available vs 30 ordered), leaving a 22-unit shortfall.
uncertainties: Replenishment ETA for SKU-404 to WH-ATL is unknown, so the remaining 22 units’ delivery timing cannot be confirmed.
Customer acceptance of a partial shipment is unknown.

recommended_actions.details: Rush replenish at least 22 units of SKU-404 to WH-ATL to cover the shortfall before the promised delivery date (evidence: check_inventory shows 8 available vs 30 ordered; find_alternative_stock shows no single alternate warehouse can cover 22).
Immediately ship the 8 available units of SKU-404 from WH-ATL now and backorder the remaining 22 units (evidence: check_inventory at WH-ATL available 8).

Inform Bluebird Labs that only 8 units can ship now and 22 units are backordered; provide an ETA once replenishment is booked (evidence: get_order_details status PENDING_FULFILLMENT and check_inventory shortage of 22 units).

arguments.recommendation: Ship the 8 available units now, rush-replenish 22 units to WH-ATL, and notify the customer about the backorder and updated ETA.
